findings.message: `_legacy_status([])` returns `UNHEALTHY`, so a deployment that simply has no triggerer (and likewise no Dag processor, line 141) now reports `status: "unhealthy"` where it previously reported `null` -- the absent component is collapsed into the failure branch instead of surfacing as unknown. Keep `triggerer_status`/`dag_processor_status` as `None` when the job list is empty and reserve `UNHEALTHY` for a component that exists but has no live instance; `detailed_status: "down"` already carries the no-jobs case for callers that want it.
